rider.name: Rider Transit
rider.fare_note: One free transfer to any Rider route. Pay with cash, the free Umo app, or a Rider Pass smartcard ($2 at the Transit Center).
rider.hours_text: Monday–Friday 5:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 8:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.

transit_center.name: Rider Transit Center
transit_center.lobby: Customer service Monday–Friday 6:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m., weekends 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

rider.bikes: Every bus has a front rack for two bikes.

paratransit.name: Rider ADA Paratransit
paratransit.fare_note: each way (the bus fare is $1.25). A personal care assistant rides free; one companion pays the same fare.
paratransit.reservation_hours_text: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.
paratransit.what: Shared, curb-to-curb rides (drivers help door to door as needed) for people whose disability keeps them from using Rider's buses. Same days and hours as the buses.
how: Call 704-920-5876 for an application, or download it below. Rider then sends a form to your doctor and does an eligibility assessment.
You'll hear back in writing within 21 days of the assessment. Eligibility can be unconditional, conditional (some trips) or temporary.
Book rides the day before, up to 60 days ahead, at 704-920-5858. Pickup is set within an hour of the time you ask for.
Be ready 15 minutes either side of your pickup time; the van waits up to 5 minutes.
Cancel at least 90 minutes before pickup. Missing three or more trips (or 10%) in 30 days can lead to a suspension.
paratransit.visitors: Visitors certified for ADA paratransit at home can ride up to 21 days a year.
